tools.name: set_browsergpt_license
tools.description: Save BrowserGPT license when MCP headers did not already provide it (Authorization Bearer license). Optional when Nova/SecOps derived license from auth. Call before list_browsers only if license_not_set.

tools.name: list_browsers
tools.description: List BrowserGPT browser nodes (local + remote) for the configured license.

tools.name: ensure_remote_runner
tools.description: Start/prepare Nova remote BrowserGPT runner (ensure-remote-browser). Call when list_browsers shows no online+ready remote node; then list_browsers again.

tools.name: open_control_session
tools.description: Open MCP control session on target browser node_id.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List tabs in the open control session.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Accessibility snapshot with refs.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: JPEG screenshot of the session viewport.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate a tab to URL. Pass tab_id from browser_tabs to reuse an existing tab; omit or leave empty to use the active control tab. Returns tab_id in results[0].tab_id.

tools.name: browser_get_cookies
tools.description: Read session data for a tab via BrowserGPT extension: chrome.cookies (HttpOnly), optional localStorage/sessionStorage keys. Operator must approve the in-tab permission prompt. Use for session export / porting auth; do not paste values into chat.

tools.name: browser_exec_js
tools.description: Run JavaScript on a target tab (same CDP evaluate path as BrowserGPT Quick Task exec_js). Requires tab_id from browser_tabs. Returns ok, value, logs, metrics.

tools.name: browser_actions
tools.description: Low-level action batch (JSON array string). Pass tab_id when batch includes switch_tab, close_tab, mouse_click, scroll, or keys.

tools.name: browser_interact
tools.description: Interact via snapshot ref.

tools.name: list_input_methods
tools.description: List BrowserGPT dom input method ids; optional page_url for domain-specific hint.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click by snapshot ref (Cursor parity). Snapshot first.

tools.name: browser_fill
tools.description: Fill field by ref.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type into field by ref.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press keyboard key in tab.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll wheel; optional ref scrolls element into view first.

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select options on a select ref.

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Drag between viewport coordinates.

tools.name: browser_mouse_click_xy
tools.description: Click at viewport x/y when snapshot refs are empty.

tools.name: browser_get_bounding_box
tools.description: Get ref bounding box from last snapshot.

tools.name: browser_highlight
tools.description: Briefly outline ref on page.

tools.name: browser_dom_input
tools.description: Run dom input method chain (e.g. 2,7,0); use after list_input_methods on stubborn fields.
